// diagnostic E0518

Jet.WriteMarkNeverWritten

`{name}` gives write access, but the body never writes through it

What

`{name}` gives write access, but the body never writes through it

Why

`^` tells every caller that the function changes the value it lends; on a dead-key layout a typed `^^` can also arrive as `^`, which lends the value instead of taking it

Fix

Remove the `^` so `{name}` is read, or write `^^` if the function takes it (on a dead-key layout type `^` then a space, twice)

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.WriteMarkNeverWritten: Tests/UI/dead_key_take_collapse.stderr.

    |          ^^
 Why: `^` tells every caller that the function changes the value it lends; on a dead-key layout a typed `^^` can also arrive as `^`, which lends the value instead of taking it
 Fix: Remove the `^` so `xs` is read, or write `^^` if the function takes it (on a dead-key layout type `^` then a space, twice)
